events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Best bet: Grand Haven, by boat.** Rating **2 (average)**. Fish 90-120 ft of water, with lines around 55-100 ft down.
- **Backup: Muskegon, by boat.** Rating **2 (average)**. Start near the breakwalls and work out to about 80 ft.
- **St. Joseph: rating 1, low confidence.** Its newest salmon report is 20 days old.
- **South Haven: rating 1, low confidence.** Same problem: its newest report is 20 days old.
- **Lures:** glow spoons and glow plugs have been the consistent producers. Blue or green spoons and white flasher-fly combos also worked at Grand Haven and St. Joseph.
- **Timing:** fish first light and low-light periods, when the reports say the glow lures worked best.
- **Wind:** check the forecast before you go. Gusts reached 42 mph at Grand Haven the week before 9/1, and I don't have a live forecast.

## Why

- **Grand Haven and Muskegon are the only ports with recent boat reports.** The Aug 19 Grand Haven and Muskegon reports both rated boat fishing average, and the Aug 12 Grand Haven report rated it good.
- **Grand Haven edges Muskegon on recent boat results.** Its Aug 12 boat report was good (quality 3), while Muskegon's Aug 12 boat report was slow because the water was too warm.
- **I'd expect St. Joseph and South Haven to be uncertain.** Their only salmon report is from Aug 12, and I'd expect that to be out of date after 20 days of changing water.
- **Glow lures are the consistent producers.** The Aug 19 and Aug 26 reports both say glow plugs or spoons worked, so I'd lead with them.

## Evidence

**Recent reports**
- **Grand Haven, 2026-08-26:** Pier anglers caught salmon from the pierheads in 70 ft of water, quality 3 (good). This report had no boat entry. (Grand Haven, 2026-08-26)
- **Grand Haven, 2026-08-19:** Boat anglers found salmon 55-100 ft down in 90-120 ft of water, quality 2 (average). Glow plugs worked well in low light. Offshore boats at 200-250 ft found coho and steelhead, not rated. (Grand Haven, 2026-08-19)
- **Grand Haven, 2026-08-12:** Boat anglers caught salmon 50-90 ft down in 85-150 ft of water, quality 3 (good). Blue and green spoons and a white flasher-fly combo worked. (Grand Haven, 2026-08-12)
- **Muskegon, 2026-08-26:** Boat anglers caught salmon from the breakwalls out to 80 ft of water, not rated. Glow plugs and glow spoons worked best. (Muskegon, 2026-08-26)
- **Muskegon, 2026-08-19:** Boat anglers caught fair numbers of Chinook 50-100 ft down in 90-170 ft of water, quality 2 (average). Coho were quality 1. They targeted 90-120 ft at first light. (Muskegon, 2026-08-19)
- **Muskegon, 2026-08-12:** Boat anglers caught salmon 50-85 ft down in 100-140 ft of water, but the report said anglers were unsuccessful due to warm water, quality 0 (slow). (Muskegon, 2026-08-12)
- **South Haven, 2026-08-12:** Boat anglers found a fair number of salmon 45-90 ft down in 100-130 ft of water, quality 2 (average). Green or blue glow spoons worked. This is the only South Haven salmon report in the last four weeks. (South Haven, 2026-08-12)
- **St. Joseph, 2026-08-12:** Boat anglers found salmon with a few steelhead 55-80 ft down in 90-120 ft of water, not rated. White flasher-fly combos and glow spoons produced the most bites. This is the only St. Joseph salmon report in the last four weeks. (St. Joseph, 2026-08-12)

**Past seasons**
- I didn't pull historical data for this answer, so I have no seasonal comparison.

**Conditions now**
- The conditions tool returned a summary for the week before 9/1, not live data. Grand Haven's buoy averaged 70 F, up 2 F over that week. The satellite reading near the Grand Haven pier also averaged 70 F, up 2 F. (Grand Haven, week before 2026-09-01)
- The same week had 3 hours of upwelling-favorable wind in the last 3 days at Grand Haven, and none at Muskegon. (Grand Haven and Muskegon, week before 2026-09-01)
- Gusts reached 42 mph at Grand Haven and 39 mph at Muskegon that week, with averages near 9 mph. (Grand Haven and Muskegon, week before 2026-09-01)

## Caveats

- **Report age:** The newest Grand Haven and Muskegon reports are from Aug 26, six days old. St. Joseph and South Haven's are from Aug 12, 20 days old, so their ratings are low-confidence.
- **Conditions are not current:** The water and wind figures are from the week before 9/1, because live data was unavailable. Check current water and the forecast before you go.
- **Ratings are my judgment:** The 0-4 ratings come from combining recent reports, not from a single source. Two of the most recent boat reports were not rated.
- **Boat safety:** Gusts near 40 mph were recorded the week before 9/1. If the forecast is similar, take the pier or stay near shore.

## Sources

- Grand Haven and Muskegon, 2026-08-26: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/426de2b
- Grand Haven and Muskegon, 2026-08-19: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/425abbc
- Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven and St. Joseph, 2026-08-12: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/424a154
